name: horizun-pbi-mcp
description: Build, audit, diagnose and repair local Power BI Desktop models and PBIP reports with DAX, TOM, TMDL and PBIR.

interface.shortDescription: Build, audit and repair Power BI projects
interface.longDescription: Use Horizun for local Power BI work: diagnose DAX, query and edit semantic models, audit PBIP projects, and author PBIR pages and visuals with previews, backups and post-write validation. It does not administer Power BI Service or Fabric cloud resources.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Power BI project and prioritize the fixes.
Diagnose why this DAX measure returns the wrong result.
Create and validate a PBIR report page from my specification.
